questions.prompt: Complete this line from a singer's portrait: "She ___ her first album in 2015."
questions.explanation: "in 2015" is a finished past date, and a finished past date kills the present perfect, so the sentence takes the simple past: "released". "has released" counts a total up to now and cannot carry a past date, while "releases" and "is releasing" describe the present instead of a finished event.

questions.prompt: Complete: "Nour began her career in 2010, and she ___ in six countries so far."
questions.explanation: "so far" counts a total up to now and gives no finished past date, so the sentence takes the present perfect: "has toured". "tours" would turn the total into a present habit, while "toured" and "was touring" close the count in the past, which "so far" does not allow.

questions.prompt: Your friend says the press asks too many private questions, and you think exactly the same. Which reply is correct English?
questions.explanation: "agree" is a verb, never an adjective, so English says "I agree with you." The forms "I am agree with you." and "I am agreed with you." add the verb "to be" in front of a verb, and "I agree to you." takes the wrong preposition: you agree with a person.

questions.prompt: Complete: "She has been a singer ___ more than ten years."
questions.explanation: "more than ten years" is a length of time, and a length of time takes "for": she has been a singer for more than ten years. "since" introduces a starting point, as in "since 2015", and neither "during" nor "from" can introduce a duration in this pattern.

questions.prompt: Read this portrait: "Everybody calls her Nour, but her real name is Nour Belhaj Amara. She was born in Bizerte in 1994, and she now lives in Sousse with her husband and their two sons." Which words give her place of residence?
questions.explanation: A place of residence is the town where somebody lives today, and the text hides it behind the verb "live": "now lives in Sousse". "she was born in Bizerte" gives her place of birth, "with her husband" gives her marital status, and "in 1994" gives the year of her birth.
